ui_pass_checks.prose_14_vs_12: Observed: 14 px body sentences on sites-empty, foundation form intro, sld unknown-part, asset unknown-asset, readiness closing note (B1-07). Asset `.prose` lead matches at 12 px.

ui_pass_checks.plural_1_incidents: Not applicable: no count+noun copy on these screens.
ui_pass_checks.domainActionClient_generic_window_error: Not applicable: no domain-action window inputs on these screens; the Foundation reserve form was not submitted (capture-only).

blockers: B1-50: changes applied/effect states (s601b/s602b) and asset s701 states need producer DBs named assetops_s601b*/s602b*/s701_owner* that must not end in _test, which conflicts with the audit DB rule assetops_audit_b1*_test.

differences.observed: Mock topbar (org path 'Bineyame Operations / Demo estate', Find a screen, Site picker, Window picker, avatar) is absent on every screen at 1440 and 390.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 shell row: no global search, user menu or shared topbar slot. R88/R112 cover only the Work-page Window control (cold/EV Work) and do not extend to these screens.

differences.observed: Short 390 pages: the dark mobile header band stretches to 165 px (changes no-selection), 157 px (changes unknown-id) and 369 px (asset unknown-site refusal), against 92 px on normal pages and no dark band in the mock (white topbar).
differences.proposed_disposition: (c) D3 shell defect = carried UI-pass item 'tall dark shell header on short 390 pages'. Shared shell fix owner.

differences.observed: At 390 the app shows a 92 px dark brand band with a Menu button where the mock shows a white topbar (org path, Site picker, Window, avatar) and hides the rail.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D2 shell row (W1-F5a carry 5 phone Menu); no register row exists.

differences.observed: Rail: Assets and Settings show 'Not available yet' (mock live); mock rail footer 'Demo workspace / 3 sites - illustrative records' absent; 'Open Simulator Lab' vs mock 'Simulator Lab'.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 for unmounted global Assets/Settings (relate to R09, which is maintenance-preventive only); footer = candidate D4 (illustrative count).

differences.observed: W1 state-line pattern: status strip carries version select, 'As of', 'How this was worked out', and panels close with 'Advanced details'/'Technical details' disclosures; mock strips are one line with no disclosures.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D2 shell-pattern row (W1-UX provenance/state line, owner-accepted conditionally in W1); no Rxx exists.

differences.observed: Mock closes each page with a bordered info callout (11 px). App: readiness renders its closing note as an unboxed 14 px paragraph; sites, sld and changes have none; asset has a different callout ('Unknown here means...').
differences.proposed_disposition: readiness 14 px unboxed note: (c) D3 typography/structure (callout primitive exists). Missing sites/sld/changes callouts: (b) candidate D4 (mock texts assert illustrative facts: reporting dots, illustrative proposal). Asset: see B1-64.

differences.observed: Body sentences render at 14 px against mock 11-12 px: sites empty (5 paragraphs at 14 px), foundation reserve-form intro, sld unknown-part notice, asset unknown-asset refusal text, readiness closing note. These screens use no `.prose` class; the one mock `.prose` (asset Interpretation lead, 12 px) is matched at 12 px.
differences.proposed_disposition: (c) D3 shared typography = carried UI-pass '.prose 14 px vs 12 px' item; shared typography fix owner.

differences.observed: Sub-tab row Directory / Add site - form / From template / Batch upload / Setup history is absent; app shows a 'Create a site in the Simulator Lab' button instead, with no 'Not available yet' label.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (site-create-form/-template/-batch-upload/-setup-history are outside W1-W6). Unlabelled today, so it needs the visible label.

differences.observed: Type chips: All sites, Mini-grid only (mock adds Cold-chain, EV charging).
differences.proposed_disposition: Value/data: the fixture stores only a mini-grid Site. If the chips are derived from stored types, there is no disposition. Architect to verify that they are data-derived; if they are fixed, candidate D4.

differences.observed: Metric cards Needs attention and Evidence limited read 'Not available' with a reason, where the mock shows counts.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (no cross-site assessment/aggregation contract).

differences.observed: Site inventory columns: mock Assessment / Top issue / Evidence / Last analysed are collapsed into one 'Operating view: Not available yet' column; app adds Setup details (disclosure) and Actions (View) columns and a footnote line.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 for the four missing columns, plus candidate D2 for the added Setup details/Actions columns.

differences.observed: Mode chip: app shows green 'Demonstration data' where the mock shows a neutral/purple 'Simulated' provenance chip. Green is the healthy/success tone.
differences.proposed_disposition: Wording: candidate D4. Tone: (c) D3 candidate (a provenance label uses a status-success tone; a neutral token exists).

differences.observed: In setup: header buttons (+ Form, From template, Batch upload) absent; columns Created by / State / Next step / Created replaced by Lifecycle; closing 'Setup progress not available' line.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (no setup-progress read or create flows).

differences.observed: Subtitle 'Every site configured in this build.' vs mock 'Find and compare sites across the operating estate'; mock root breadcrumb 'Sites >' above the h1 is absent.
differences.proposed_disposition: Subtitle: candidate D4. Breadcrumb: (c) minor D3 candidate (faithfully renderable).

differences.observed: Panel title 'Identity and operating obligations' vs mock 'Identity & operating obligations'. Approved in W1-F1, but there is no register row.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D2 row (plain-language 'and').

differences.observed: Topology cards use paired icons and underlined part links where the mock has a single centred icon; the AC bus rule is blue in the app and green/teal in the mock.
differences.proposed_disposition: Links/icons: candidate D2 (part selection carries ?component to SLD/readiness). Bus colour: (c) D3 candidate (colour token mismatch).

differences.observed: Identity panel: 10 rows vs 6; values sit in a left-aligned second column without row rules (mock: right-aligned values with rules); monospace 'KOBO-001' wraps to 'KOBO-/001'. Topology panel is stretched to the same row height (1.50x at 1440).
differences.proposed_disposition: Rows: data (W1-F5b overage reason carried; needs a register ruling for >1.3x). KV alignment and code wrap: (c) D3 candidate.

differences.observed: Control table: 5 rows vs 4 (adds Critical service order); Evidence/change cells are plain text where the mock has links (Published policy, Review proposed change, Constraint evidence, See actual operation); one 'Open Dispatch' link exists.
differences.proposed_disposition: Extra row: data. Missing links: candidate D1 (no change list or constraint-evidence target).

differences.observed: The working 'Change the battery reserve' form (intro, two fields, Publish) and 'Advanced details' sit inside Time-valid control configuration, which is not drawn in the mock. Panel is 2.64x (1440) and 2.93x (390).
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D2 (S6 publish capability placed on Foundation) with a measured >1.3x reason. Needs a reviewed ruling.

differences.observed: No-version state (?at=2026-09-01): h1 shows the Site code 'KOBO-001' instead of the stored display name 'Kobo mini-grid', although the Site read returns display_name.
differences.proposed_disposition: (c) D3 candidate, pending an Architect check of whether the name must come from the Foundation version (then D1).

differences.observed: Panel title 'Gateway status - edge-kobo-001' vs mock 'GW-MG-01' (dynamic from the selected read; approved in W1-F1). No-version title 'Gateway status - No gateway selected'.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D4 (illustrative gateway id replaced by the selected record).

differences.observed: Readiness table: last column 'Next step' vs mock 'Owner'; 6 areas vs 5, with different area names; three note lines and a disclosure under the table (1.63x/1.99x).
differences.proposed_disposition: 'Owner': candidate D1 (no owner field). Next step and notes: candidate D2. >1.3x carried W1-F5b reason needs a ruling.

differences.observed: Gateway panel: the contact timeline bar and legend are absent; Availability and Data completeness read 'Not available'; app adds a Registered gateway/Registration/Central contact block and a diagnostic disclosure (1.47x/1.55x).
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (no uptime/completeness source) plus candidate D2 for the added block. Needs a ruling for >1.3x.

differences.observed: Panel title 'Kobo mini-grid' with no '- AC-coupled mini-grid' suffix; the subtitle says 'Topology type not stated in this version'. The W1-F1 packet recorded the title '{site name} - {site type}'.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (topology type not declared in Foundation). Architect to check this against the W1-F1 approved title: if the type suffix regressed, it is a D3.

differences.observed: Protection (CBs), feeder kWh meters, the Monitoring & communication row and reporting-status dots are absent; each part reads 'Readings not assessed here'; legend DC/AC/Fuel vs mock AC/DC/Monitoring/Circuit breaker/Reporting/Gap/Not connected.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 for mini SLD (R36 is the EV-only analogue).

differences.observed: 'What each part does' columns are Part / Type / Declared rating / Channels with 10 per-part rows, against mock Part / Role at this site / What it reports with 4 grouped rows.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (no role/reporting description stored) plus candidate D2 (per-part rows). Panel 2.23x at 1440, 1.95x at 390: measured reason is the 10 rows plus the intro and disclosure; needs a ruling.

differences.observed: Diagram panel is 1.63x/1.84x at 1440 and 3.84x/4.51x at 390. At 390 the app keeps the drawing full size in an inner horizontal scroller (952 px in 316 px), while the mock scales the diagram down to 318 px tall.
differences.proposed_disposition: Needs a reviewed ruling: candidate D2 (readability) or, if scale-to-fit is the faithful alternative, (c) D3. Measured reason: 9 parts in 4 rows plus a selected-part box and notes.

differences.observed: BLOCKED: the representative populated (applied / effect) change state could not be captured. The s601b/s602b producers refuse any DB name ending in _test, and this audit may only use assetops_audit_b1*_test. The v01a data has no change records (action_policy_change 0 rows).
differences.proposed_disposition: Blocker for the coordinator. Rerun with an authorised assetops_s601b* audit DB, or authorise a name exception.

differences.observed: No-selection and unknown-ID states: an amber notice 'No change selected... no list of Foundation changes yet' and two panels with one-line gap statements; the mock has a strip, 4 KPI cards, a before/proposed table, decision steps and a callout. Panel titles and order match (2/2).
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (no Foundation change list); honest missing state.

differences.observed: Asset-rooted chrome absent: the mock has the Assets rail entry active, breadcrumb Assets > BAT-001 > Health, asset tabs (Overview, Health, Performance, Configuration, Work, Evidence, Warranty) and an 'Open site' button. The app is Site-rooted (Sites active, Site tabs, breadcrumb Sites / Kobo mini-grid / Health / Battery).
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (asset-* screens are outside W1-W6).

differences.observed: Panel 3 title 'Condition evidence and its limits' vs mock 'Condition evidence and claim boundary'.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D2 (client-facing plain language); no register row.

differences.observed: Reserve exposure and Power stress read 'Not available'; the weekly breach bars are absent (a KV list stands in); KPI top-border tones are absent.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1 (no accepted SOC/power history on this page).

differences.observed: Interpretation: 3 numbered missing inputs vs 2 actions; 'Create test action' and 'Review capability gap' links absent (capacity-test action stated unavailable). 1.31x at 390.
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D1. The ~1.31x carries the W1-F5b reason and needs a ruling.

differences.observed: Warranty callout replaced by 'Unknown here means not yet measurable... Back to Health'; 'Technical details' disclosure added.
differences.proposed_disposition: Warranty: candidate D1. Disclosure: covered by B1-05 D2.

differences.observed: h1 'Battery energy storage' (Foundation display name) vs 'Kobo battery'; subtitle has no asset code (mock BAT-001).
differences.proposed_disposition: (b) candidate D4 (illustrative name/code).

differences.observed: Refusals: unknown asset on KOBO-001 gives an in-frame refusal at 14 px (B1-07); unknown Site gives 'Site not found' / 'No such site' (1 panel vs mock 3) with the 369 px band at 390 (B1-02). W1-F5b's 3-slot refusal (stored KOBO-002 without a battery) cannot be reproduced: v01a data stores no KOBO-002, and the s701 producer is blocked as in B1-50.
differences.proposed_disposition: Refusal structure: existing W1-F5b accepted pattern (no Rxx). Architect to confirm or register it. Producer gap: blocker note.
